claim: Takeoff angles from the RFS tool mean what the model assumes
test: Code reading of CouplingCalculations.cs and SpreadsheetIO.cs; MATLAB on-path gain vs the C# offset rule on three hand cases
key_result: Convention matches: both take the takeoff angle from the local horizontal, positive up, and use takeoff - tilt; on three hand cases MATLAB minus the C# rule is at most 1.9e-12 dB. Earth curvature sits in the propagation model's takeoff angle; MATLAB takes the angle as given. New: CalculateWorstCaseCoupling_dBi passes otherAntModel1 for antenna 2 (should be otherAntModel2).
